newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks in London benefit from rising Dow.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks in London benefit from rising Dow.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks in London pushed slightly higher on Tuesday as the market continued to benefit from a recovery in shares on Wall Street, traders said.

The Hang Seng London Reference index was up 2.52 points, or 0.02 percent, at 13,344.98 by 1456 GMT. In Hong Kong, stocks advanced to a strong finish with the Hang Seng index ending 198.23 points higher at 13,342.46.

"A fall in Hong Kong Bank brought us down earlier...and put pressure on other stocks," said one trader. "But there's some buying around for property stocks, which has helped the rally from its low," he added.
One trader said Hong Kong's strong close on Tuesday should help propel the market higher on Wednesday. "But obviously it depends on what Wall Street does," he added.
By 1457 GMT, the Dow was up 12.67 points at 6,476.61.
